turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Example: My dad (drive) a bus. I write: My dad drives a bus. Dad means he, so I add -s.
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: He paints pictures. Wrong: He paint pictures.
Now you try. Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
